component.name: Gans
component.summary: Ente Auth 2FA codes, one keystroke away

description.p: Gans is a tray-resident client for Ente Auth, the open-source two-factor authenticator. It signs in to your Ente account, syncs your end-to-end encrypted codes, and keeps them one keystroke away.

ul.li: Quick Search: press the global hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+Space by default), type to filter, press Return, and the current code is typed straight into the field that had focus.
Tray menu: every entry with its live code; click one to copy it.
End-to-end encrypted: your password never leaves the device, secrets are decrypted in memory only, and the on-disk cache holds nothing but Ente's already-encrypted data.
Optional app lock that asks for your account password before showing codes.
